about: Phase 1 survey for the 50-state contractor-license set (docs/plans/state-contractor-license-plan.md). Every non-null field was read on the official page on checkedOn. Types: A statewide GC/residential license; B trades only; C registration; D local only; E mix.

bodies: Alabama Licensing Board for General Contractors
rows.typeQuote: The mission of the State of Alabama Home Builders Licensure Board is to provide consumer protection by safeguarding the public's health, safety and welfare through the regulation of the residential construction and remodeling industries
rows.notes: GC board site notes: "Changes to Section 34-8-7 of the Code of Alabama will take effect October 1, 2026". HBLB statute TBD.

bodies: Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing (construction contractor program)
rows.typeQuote: General contractors that oversee new home construction or perform residential work greater than 25% of the value of a structure being altered must obtain a Residential Contractor license and/or a Residential Contractor Endorsement.
rows.notes: Endorsement needs a 16-hour cold climate course and an exam.
Cloudflare check; owner sent homepage PDF 2026-11-13
